note: City of Wayne park opened 2025 on a reclaimed sewage-lagoon site at the SE edge of town, beside the Summer Sports Complex. The pull-through pads are angled in one row along the south side of a stocked fishing pond (the city calls it a four-acre lake; pier, kayak launch, walking trail around it), across the campground road from it. --Claude
summary: Rec1 booking catalog confirms 17 drive-through full-hookup pads (50/30 A), shower house, 180-day booking, 14 days in 30, open April 1-October 31, $35 a night (2026); written. Waterfront: the city's own figure is a four-acre lake (imagery ~2-3 acres of water), under the 5-acre pond line, and the campground road runs between the pads and the shore: lakeview -> not waterfront (lead).
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview -> not waterfront (lead, AWH 2026-11-01 pond rule): the city page calls it 'a four-acre lake' (cityofwayne.org/840); a pixel count on Esri imagery gives ~2.1 acres of open water in the main basin plus a separate ~0.3-acre pond NE of it. Under ~5 acres is a pond with no pond-view. The pads are a single row of angled pull-throughs between two gravel campground roads; the north road (and the riprap shore strip) lies between every pad and the water, ~15-30 m. Even if counted as a lake, the loop road would cap it at lakeview. The creek south of the campground is behind the city trail and a treeline and a few metres wide.

PHONE: the Rec1 booking catalog gives 402-375-4803 (Wayne Community Activity Center, which runs the bookings); stored 402-375-1733 is the City of Wayne main line (cityofwayne.org). Either works; the booking number may be better. apply.py doesn't write phone.
